title: A 900-Ton Radio Telescope Platform Crashed 450 Feet Into Its Own Dish

scenes.text: December 1, 2020. Arecibo Observatory, Puerto Rico. Just before eight in the morning.
The platform hung from cables above a giant dish. Those cables were failing.
In August, one slipped and tore a hundred-foot gash in the dish. In November, a main cable broke.
Then the platform came down, onto the dish below.
Nine hundred tons. Four hundred fifty feet. Nobody was hurt.

description:
A 900-ton platform fell about 450 feet when the Arecibo radio telescope collapsed on December 1, 2020.
An auxiliary cable slipped in August and a main cable broke in November before the platform came down on the dish. No one was injured.
Which building or machine would you most hate to see fall? Comment below.
first_comment: The platform fell onto the dish below. The telescope had been used for decades. What famous machine would you hate to lose?
